Name: Anthro Sasuke Portrait Mod - Furry Black Goat (With No Glasses Alt)
Author: ImRikun
Description:
Latest Version: 0.1

Special thanks to hamnugh for making the original mod, and making Sasuke into the... er... "special" character that he is...?

--> --> --> --> IMPORTANT INFO - The Sasuke NPC mod is currently not available for download, see tweet below for more info! <-- <-- <-- <--

https://twitter.com/hamnugh/status/1548418505933930497?t=zy3psRK4mpZvHHgsNKkXuQ&s=19

[b]Warning: Sasuke is not for everyone, he has some pretty off-putting dialogue and events. He is a comedic parody of the average 4channer, and does not represent my own personal views, nor those of hamnugh.[/b]
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]
[color=#ea9999]Installation Guide - Please Read![/color][/color][/b][/size]

1. Download and install the Sasuke NPC Mod here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7232

2. Open the "Sasuke NPC" folder, then the "Assets" folder, and finally the "Image" folder. There should be 2 png files inside.

3 Download my Anthro Sasuke Mod, and extract them to your desktop (or any other folder.)

4. When you open it up, you'll see 3 png files inside:

SasukeGlasses.png, SasukeNoGlasses.png & Sprite.png

5: Choose between SasukeGlasses or SasukeNoGlasses, and rename the one you want to "Sasuke.png"

6. Copy and paste Sasuke.png and Sprite.png into the Image folder from step 2, and select "Replace All" (Optionally backup the original sprites if you'd like to go back to them later.)

8. Pat yourself on the back, you did it! :)

[b][color=#ffe599][size=4]More Info[/size][/color][/b]

If you have any issues with the mod, feel free to reach out and I'll take a look!

I actually made this before my Sorren furry mod, so the portrait sprites aren't as pretty. I do plan on returning to this mod later, but figured I should work on some new NPC portraits for now!

If I'm being honest, I have no idea what animal I was going for here, like I wanted the whole "black sheep" motif, but I also thought a goat look would be kinda cool, but wait... were rams and goats the same thing? ... Let's just call him Bleat-Boy!

While I originally made this edit to use it with the Anthro Characters Continued mod, my art style is a bit more subdued and less cartoony, feel free to make your own edits of this mod, but please make sure to credit me on it! :3

Be on the lookout for other custom NPC anthro edit mods, feel free to comment your suggestions for NPCs you'd like to see me work on next!

The next two will be... a certain infamous geologist, and a certain kitty loving beekeeper!
